finalists.label: Malacoplakia of the Urinary Bladder
finalists.why: It has specific findings of tiny hyperechoic foci and a well-defined soft-tissue–density lesion with calcific specks along the anterosuperior bladder wall.

finalists.label: Urinary Tract Infection
finalists.why: It is supported by symptoms of dysuria and laboratory findings of red blood cells and pus cells in the urinalysis.

finalists.label: Transitional Cell Carcinoma
finalists.why: It is indicated by imaging findings of a focal hypoechoic polypoidal lesion and a well-defined soft-tissue–density lesion with calcific specks and heterogeneous enhancement.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive imaging findings, including the size and characteristics of the lesion and its enhancement pattern.
